purpose: Freeze a synthetic navigation/viewing-geometry modulation before receipt of BODC/NOC TOBI primary bytes, so later tape navigation can be compared without retuning. This is a calibration layer, not an independent morphology prediction.

public_log_inputs.source: NOC Southampton Cruise Report No. 6 — RRS Charles Darwin Cruise 169

instrument_context_from_same_report.phase_bathymetry: phase-difference sonar collected continuously for post-cruise interferometric bathymetry

deterministic_interpolation.method: local tangent-plane linear interpolation between the two published TOBI positions

monte_carlo_modulation.model: Each published endpoint latitude and longitude is independently perturbed uniformly within +/-0.0005 degree, representing only rounding/quantization of the 0.001-degree published decimal positions. This is NOT a complete navigation-error model.

viewing_geometry.interpretation: Under the published-position rounding-only ensemble, the frozen coordinate remains very close to the interpolated TOBI centerline. At the 97.5th percentile absolute cross-track distance and nominal interpolated altitude, the horizontal offset corresponds to about 5.47 degrees off nadir; at the 99.5th percentile it is about 6.32 degrees off nadir.
viewing_geometry.warning: Near-nadir geometry does not guarantee useful sidescan imaging at the exact point. Nadir-gap/beam-footprint behavior must be determined from the actual TOBI product and metadata; no nadir-gap width is assumed here.

calibration_scores: absolute error between real closest-approach time and frozen 01:07:25.275 calibration anchor
real cross-track distance of frozen coordinate to recovered TOBI navigation
whether recovered line/tow identity is CD169/JD059/TOB-02/line19
real vehicle altitude/depth/heading at closest approach versus frozen modulation envelope
unknown_signal_or_morphology_scores: MUST be frozen in a separate artifact before any target-interval TOBI image/trace content is inspected
must use the same fixed window and same metric definitions on synthetic and real data
must report negative/contradictory outcomes without retuning
later_real_data_scoring_contract.reporting_rule: Do not collapse calibration and morphology into one score. A navigation match validates registration/model geometry only; it does not validate a seafloor anomaly hypothesis.
